sections.MESSAGE_TO_USER:
mboetger left three inline comments on [#196561](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561) a few minutes before he approved. All three approvals and CI are still green, and I haven't pushed anything.

**Comment 1 ([r4606831206](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561#discussion_r4606831206), line 113):** "nit: toBigIntegerOrNull() exists"
He's right. Kotlin's stdlib `String.toBigIntegerOrNull()` would replace the try/catch around `BigInteger(value)`. This only changes how the code reads. I'll have matt561 confirm it accepts the same inputs (signs, non-ASCII digits) before we take it. It isn't worth a push by itself.

**Comments 2–3 ([r4606860038](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561#discussion_r4606860038), line 152):** "I don't think this is true. Can't submit to Play Store sure - but I was able to install with adb." / "I believe it will reject if you try to install over a build with a versionCode."
This says our KDoc on `errorMessage` is wrong. The KDoc says APKs built with `force-version-code-ignoring-abi` and no manifest `versionCode` are ones "Android refuses to install." That KDoc is also the stated reason the error message doesn't suggest the flag. So this may be more than wording:
- If a fresh `adb install` works, the KDoc is wrong.
- We may then also want the user-facing error to mention the flag, with a caveat that Play rejects these APKs and they won't install over a build that has a versionCode.

I haven't reproduced this yet, so I'm not calling it a nit or a follow-up. I'm asking matt561 to reproduce it locally (fresh install, install over a build with a versionCode, and the non-decimal case). He won't push. I'm also asking him to check whether the shipped error text repeats the claim or only the KDoc does.

**Decision: hold the merge until the repro comes back?**
- **Why it matters:** this PR goes into 3.50 and 3.51. If the user-facing error text is wrong, fixing it after landing means a follow-up PR plus two more cherry-picks. Fixing it before landing means one push, which dismisses all three approvals and reruns about an hour of presubmits.
- **1a (recommended): hold.** Don't add `autosubmit` until the repro is back; it's local work, so it should be quick. Then:
  - If only the KDoc is wrong: merge as-is and fix the KDoc and the nit in a small follow-up that doesn't need cherry-picking.
  - If the user-facing text or the decision not to suggest the flag is wrong: batch the fix and the nit into one push and get re-approvals once.
- **1b: merge now.** Handle everything in a follow-up and decide later whether it also needs cherry-picks. The risk is shipping an error message to 3.50 and 3.51 that we may then have to fix in both branches.

mboetger is a human reviewer, so I won't post replies to him. Once the repro is done, I'll bring you drafts for both threads to post.

Before any merge I'll re-run `pr_triage` and re-fetch all review threads, in case more comments arrive.

Reply "go 1a" to hold the merge until the repro is back, or "go 1b" to merge now.
sections.WORKER_BRIEF:
<WORKER-BRIEF>

- **Source:** New inline comments from `mboetger` (human reviewer) on flutter/flutter#196561. They were posted a few minutes before his approval ("Overall LGTM."). Verbatim:
  - Comment 1, `ManifestVersionCodeTaskHelper.kt` line 113, https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561#discussion_r4606831206:
    > nit: toBigIntegerOrNull() exists

    on:
    ```kotlin
    val versionCode =
        try {
            BigInteger(value)
        } catch (e: NumberFormatException) {
            null
        }
    ```
  - Comments 2–3, one thread on `ManifestVersionCodeTaskHelper.kt` line 152, https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561#discussion_r4606860038:
    > I don't think this is true.  Can't submit to Play Store sure - but I was able to install with adb.

    > I believe it will reject if you try to install over a build with a versionCode.

    on the KDoc of `errorMessage`: "Does not suggest `force-version-code-ignoring-abi`, because it cannot help here. When the manifest has no positive `versionCode`, the flag builds APKs with no `versionCode`, which Android refuses to install. When the value is not a decimal integer, AGP fails the build."

- **Claims and evidence:**
  - "`toBigIntegerOrNull()` gives the same result as `BigInteger(value)` + catch": not reproduced. Check stdlib behavior for leading `+`/`-`, an empty string, whitespace, and non-ASCII digits.
  - mboetger: "an APK with no versionCode installs fine with `adb install`": not reproduced.
  - mboetger: "it is rejected when installed over a build that has a versionCode": not reproduced.
  - Our KDoc: "Android refuses to install APKs with no versionCode": not reproduced. The comments above dispute it.
  - Our KDoc: "a non-decimal manifest versionCode makes AGP fail the build": not reproduced.

- **Task:** Reproduce, then report. Don't push.
  1. Use a test app whose `android {}` omits `versionCode` and whose main manifest has no positive `versionCode`. Build `flutter build apk --split-per-abi -P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true` from branch `vcfix-manifest-fallback` (head `f3d2ab1fd3b`). Record `aapt2 dump badging` (or `apkanalyzer manifest version-code`) for one split APK.
  2. On a device or emulator with no copy of the app installed, run `adb install <apk>`. Record the exact output.
  3. Install a build of the same app ID that has a versionCode. Then run `adb install -r` with the no-versionCode APK and record the exact output. Also try the reverse order.
  4. Set the manifest versionCode to a non-decimal value, build with the flag, and record whether AGP fails and with what error.
  5. Find out whether the user-facing error string from `errorMessage` makes the "refuses to install" claim or the "cannot help" claim. Is it only the KDoc?
  6. Confirm whether `value.toBigIntegerOrNull()` behaves the same as the current try/catch for the inputs this code can receive.

  Based on what you find, tell me whether code, tests, or docs must change. Possible answers: only the KDoc wording; the user-facing error text; whether the error should suggest the flag with caveats (Play rejection, no install over a versioned build); and tests covering any change. Give your recommendation and the reasoning. You may prepare the changes as a local commit, including the `toBigIntegerOrNull()` swap if it's equivalent.

- **Constraints:**
  - Branch `vcfix-manifest-fallback` only.
  - **Do not push.** The PR has three approvals and green CI. Any push dismisses the approvals and reruns about an hour of presubmits, and the user wants to cherry-pick this to 3.50 and 3.51. I'll decide with the user whether to push or open a follow-up.
  - If a push is approved later, push to the `reidbaker-agent` fork only.
  - mboetger is a human reviewer. Do **not** reply on GitHub. Draft a reply for each thread locally, with the change or proposal stated directly, and include them in your report.
  - Report every command you ran with its exact output, the proposed diff (if any), and each comment marked as changed, modified, or declined, with the reason.
